observations.description: kvm2 is registered as ready at kvm2.soocoo.xyz and the host detail page shows a large discovered VM inventory.
Existing kvm2 VMs include running service-like names and many test/template names; do not mutate or delete them without a clearly identified safe fixture.
VM advanced settings can be explored read-only and through previews, but real apply/rollback needs a safe fixture and authoritative post-write verification.
Advanced form defaults were not hydrated from the parsed current advanced XML; kvm2 VM has watchdog itco/reset but form showed disabled and i6300esb.

Start, enable-autostart, and configuration device actions submit directly to the task queue; the page provides confirmation for normal shutdown and delete/rename previews but not for these state mutations.
Storage volume preview took about 16 seconds; blank-disk VM preview about 60 seconds; platform-image VM preview about 60 seconds. All eventually returned 200.
